title: Nine Seconds of Listening
subtitle: 关注与注意 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 关注与注意（人与自我·专注与留心）
meta: 主题语境：关注与注意（人与自我·专注与留心）　|　核心词汇：attention　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attention 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my teacher said I had ① the attention of a nine-year-old and the handwriting of a doctor, and both were true. The ② attention, meaning the listening and not the looking, lasted about nine seconds at a time; attention, she said, is the only thing you can give away and still be poorer for. She said she had been poor in that way for eleven years.

Every ③ attention in that classroom was a negotiation, and she said that was not her fault. Their ④ attention — the kind the inspector wrote about — was nine minutes long and had been paid for with a story; attention, my father said, is the only thing a child gives you without meaning to. He said you cannot ask for it twice.

My grandmother used the word the other way and meant ⑤ attentions, plural, meaning the little things you do for somebody who is ill. The ⑥ attention, meaning the care and not the listening, is the only thing in a house that is counted in visits and never in hours; attention, she said, is what love looks like when it is in a hurry. She said most love is in a hurry.

By 1969 the  attention had moved, which is what attention does, and it had moved to the window. The ⑦ attention he paid to the clock was nine times a lesson and never once to the lesson; attention, my mother said, is the only thing that goes exactly where it wants and nowhere where it is told. She said the clock was not even accurate.

The  attention I remember is the nine seconds, which she said was nine more than most people get. ⑧ Attention, she said in 1971, is the rarest thing anybody has and the only thing everybody expects to be given twice; every attention, she said, is a gift that costs the giver everything and the receiver nothing. She said that is what makes it a gift.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 注意；注意力（一段时间、一次的注意）
B. n. 注意力（指“听进去”这件事，与“看着”相对）
C. n. 注意力（指督学写下的那种、用故事换来的）
D. 固定搭配：have the attention of 拥有……的注意力
E. n. （复数 attentions）照料；关心的举动
F. n. 关心；照料（抽象）
G. n. 注意力（指他花在钟上的那种）
H. n. 注意力（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The attention, meaning the listening and not the looking
The attention, meaning the care and not the listening
The attention he paid to the clock

answers.why: have the attention of 意为“拥有……的注意力”，1965 年老师说我有一个九岁孩子的注意力，却有一份医生的笔迹，两样都对。
attention 指“听进去”这件事，与“看着”相对，这种注意力一次大约维持九秒。
attention 意为“注意、注意力”，那间教室里的每一份注意力都是一场谈判，她说那不是她的错。
attention 指督学写下的那种注意力，长达九分钟，是用一个故事换来的。
attentions 为复数，意为“照料的举动、关心的行为”，祖母指的是为病人做的那些小事。
attention 意为“关心、照料（抽象）”，与倾听相对，它是屋里唯一按次数而不是按钟点计算的东西。
attention 指他花在钟上的那种注意力：一节课九次看钟，一次也没落在课上。
attention 为抽象总称，泛指“注意力这种东西”，她说注意力是任何人身上最稀有、却人人都指望被给第二次的东西。
